# In Plain English

> > A tech media company publishing beginner-friendly programming tutorials and guides across JavaScript, Python, TypeScript, React, AI, and software development.

In Plain English operates multiple developer-focused publications including JavaScript In Plain English, Python In Plain English, and Stackademic. The site features practical tutorials, productivity guides, and resources for developers at all skill levels, with emphasis on clear explanations and real-world applications.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Python
- TypeScript
- React
- ChatGPT and AI
- Developer Tools
- Software Development
- Programming Education
- CSS
- SaaS Development
- Mobile Development
- Backend-for-Frontend (BFF)
- UI Frameworks
- Command-Line Tools
- Developer Community

## JavaScript and TypeScript Guides

- [5 Best React UI Frameworks and Component Libraries in 2023 - A Developer's Guide](https://plainenglish.io/blog/5-best-react-ui-frameworks-and-component-libraries-in-2023): Top React UI libraries: MUI, Saas UI, Mantine, Ant Design, Tailwind
- [3 Different Ways to Import Modules in TypeScript](https://plainenglish.io/blog/3-different-ways-to-import-modules-in-typescript): TypeScript module import methods: require, import, and esModuleInterop
- [4 Ways to Check if the Property Exists in JavaScript Object](https://plainenglish.io/blog/4-ways-to-check-whether-the-property-exists-in-a-javascript-object-20c2d96d8f6e): JavaScript property checking: hasOwnProperty, in, typeof, double-bang
- [5 Ways to Convert String to Array in JavaScript](https://plainenglish.io/blog/5-ways-to-convert-string-to-array-in-javascript-4f86ce362534): JavaScript string-to-array methods: split, Array.from, spread operator
- [5 Ways To Detect Mobile Browsers in JavaScript](https://plainenglish.io/blog/5-ways-to-detect-mobile-browsers-in-javascript): Mobile browser detection: user-agent, media queries, touch events in JS
